_note: Per-OWNER, per-TILE settings — the platform pattern for tuning tile parameters. Every tile has a `params` schema (the tunable knobs, with sensible defaults). Values resolve in this order: per-owner override (owners[ownerName]) → tile default. ECH may manage for different owners, each with their own thresholds, so settings are keyed by owner with a shared default. SETUP has two paths: (1) the tile's AI EMPLOYEE walks the user through a guided Q&A (the `q` text is what the employee asks) and writes the answers here — available when employee_plugin_enabled; (2) a MANUAL settings form exposing the same params, always available, the only path when the employee plug-in isn't purchased. Front-end persists answers to localStorage per owner; backend replaces that at the connector phase. This file is the schema + defaults; nothing here is live tenant data.

employee.name: Pat
employee.intro: Hi, I’m Pat — I keep your rent roll tidy and chase what’s late. Answer a few quick questions and I’ll set this tile up the way you run things. You can change any of it later.

params.label: Grace period before rent counts late
params.q: How many days after the due date before you treat rent as late?

params.label: Days late before it’s urgent (turns red + suggest a formal notice)
params.q: After how many days late should I flag it red and recommend a formal notice?

params.label: Default late fee
params.q: What late fee do you charge by default?

params.label: Warn about leases ending within
params.q: How far ahead should I warn you that a lease is ending?
